description: 한국도로공사_주유소 가격 과 고속도로 통행량의 상관성 [roads, bridges and tunnels and fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 한국도로공사에서 제공하는 고속도로 주유소의 유가 정보와 해당 구간의 통행량 데이터를 기반으로 상관성을 분석할 수 있도록 구성된 OpenAPI 서비스이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 고속도로, 주유소, 가격, 통행량, 유가정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
